verdict.rationale: Asana has a dedicated first-party webhooks guide stating that webhooks let an application be notified of changes in Asana, and its developer platform lists webhooks among its core automation features alongside the REST API. The evidence confirms the capability exists but gives little detail on how subscriptions work. Missing for 10: documentation detail on event filtering/resource scoping, handshake and signature security, delivery/retry guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
